children: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh chaired the annual performance review of Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs), where the CMDs of seven DPSUs presented dividend cheques worth a total of ₹3,951 crore to the government against its equity holdings.
Hindustan Aeronautics (HAL) presented a dividend cheque of ₹2,155.96 crore to the government for its equity holding for FY26.
Bharat Electronics (BEL) presented an interim and final dividend cheque of ₹934.48 crore to Defence Minister Rajnath Singh for FY2025-26.
Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) presented a dividend cheque of ₹110.09 crore to the government for its equity holding for FY26.
Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders (MDL) presented a dividend cheque of ₹593.64 crore to the government for its equity holding for FY26.
BEML presented a dividend cheque of ₹21.60 crore to the government for its equity holding for FY26.
MIDHANI presents ₹11.78 crore interim dividend cheque to government for FY26
Bharat Dynamics (BDL) presented a dividend cheque of ₹123.59 crore to the government for its equity holding for FY26.

Separately, Yantra India has been accorded Mini Ratna status, while Goa Shipyard has been granted Schedule A status. Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE) has also been accorded Navratna status.

title: 7 defence PSUs present ₹3,951 crore dividend cheques to Rajnath Singh for FY26
